author: Stephanie
body: This is all new to me. I don’t need Stu 101, I need Stu Remedial classes! I’ve been following the show closely but have no idea how we got to all of the positions Stu was at. I did invest in the Massie race and made a small profit. By the time I understood the clear position for Paxton it was already too late to make anything substantial. Since I’m new I just invested $5. My $5 turned into $5.30, which pennies do make dollars. The only other position I actually made a good profit on is when I invested in the Mando movie. Turned $4 into $9.61, which was totally awesome. Have no idea how I missed all of the margins with Paxton but I did. I hope I can catch on!
